# Problem

After all skill fixes land on dev, the full test suite must be verified green before the epic can be advanced to in_review.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Run the full test suite via `python3 skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py --scope full --strict-git-env` (or `pytest -q`) and confirm 0 failures.
2. If any pre-existing red on dev is encountered, triage into a critical test-failure work item (SA-0MULPQ3BK001A1M5 precedent) and stop.
3. `wl sync` changes.
4. Report full suite result on the epic work item.
5. If suite green, advance epic stage to in_review.

## Related

- **SA-0MUUI6ZCX001RO8V** — Epic (parent).

data.description:
## Summary

**Cross-repo work item — ContextHub.** Evidence from SA-0MUIZSXEY008NGR8 confirms that `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` in `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` forwards `...process.env` to every spawned pane process. If the herdr process itself has inherited repository-override variables (e.g., from a parent process or git hook chain), these propagate to every agent/test session.

This work item owns the fix: scrub repository-overrides in the herdr spawn path so child processes never inherit repository-override git variables.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` in `downtime-worker.ts` filters all `REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE_ENV_VARS` from the forwarded environment.
- [ ] The scrub is applied in `send-to-pi.sh` and/or `run-pi-agent.sh` as a shell-side defence layer.
- [ ] A ContextHub regression test verifies the spawn path scrubs repository-override variables.
- [ ] Agent/test sessions spawned via herdr panes inherit no repository-override git variables.

## Linked Work Items

- Parent investigation: **SA-0MUIZSXEY008NGR8** (SorraAgents — investigation + evidence).
- SorraAgents regression test: linked child of SA-0MUIZSXEY008NGR8.
data.title: Cross-repo ContextHub: scrub repository-overrides in herdr spawn path

## Cross-repo fix filed and implemented in ContextHub

Per the parent's Q1 = A decision (fix lands in a linked cross-repo ContextHub
work item), the launcher-side fix is implemented and pushed in ContextHub:

- **ContextHub work item:** `WL-0MV0TZEWZ003ZXEB` — "Scrub repository-override git vars in herdr spawn path" (completed / in_review).
- **Commit:** `daa7d2a9` on `origin/dev` (`10699fa3..daa7d2a9`).

### Changes (in ContextHub)

- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` — added `REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE_ENV_VARS` + `scrubRepositoryOverrides()`; `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` now forwards `{ ...scrubRepositoryOverrides(process.env), ... }`.
- `packages/herdr/shared/send-to-pi.sh`, `packages/herdr/shared/run-pi-agent.sh` — `unset` the override variables as a shell-side defence.
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` — regression tests for the scrub and the spawn options.

### AC → cross-repo coverage

| AC | Evidence |
|----|----------|
| `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` filters all `REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE_ENV_VARS` | `scrubRepositoryOverrides(process.env)` in the `env` field; test `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions scrubs repository-override git vars`. |
| Scrub in `send-to-pi.sh` and/or `run-pi-agent.sh` | `unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_CONFIG* GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` in both scripts (`bash -n` clean). |
| ContextHub regression test | `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` — 86 herdr files / 3308 tests pass, `tsc --noEmit` clean. |
| Spawned sessions inherit no overrides | SorraAgents evidence child SA-0MV0G9BVW008M8AT: live `/proc` dump + `--session-env` both clean. |

### SorraAgents scope

No SorraAgents code change was required — the in-repo regression boundary is
already covered by `tests/test_repository_override_isolation.py` and
`skill/shared/tests/test_git_sandbox.py` (see child SA-0MV0G9CD1007A0IC). This
item is closed as the cross-repo tracking/fix item.
